_doc: Named Colab runs for colab/dcad.py. data: dataset names (Drive: dcad/datasets/<name>.tar); clean_blue_per_task: N clean sim demos per blue task (first N of sim_blue_v2c_24); phone: 'all' | 'blue' (phone_v2 replays, all tasks or blue only); ambient: true adds --ambient_t_min defaults.ambient_t_min (chosen from the small-policy sweep; null = not chosen yet, ambient runs refuse to start); train: extra train_smolvla.py args (added to defaults.train); probe: extra probe args; eval_k: episodes/task for the final eval (0 = skip); eval_steps: checkpoints to evaluate (default: the latest); init_from: continue another run's latest checkpoint (weights + optimizer). Add a new entry per experiment; never edit one that has run (its checkpoints on Drive were made with those args). eval_args: extra eval args for every eval of the run; eval_variants: [[tag, args], ...] evaluated per step (e.g. normal vs zero-noise sampling). probe_step: checkpoint(s) to probe (default all). Task-balanced sampling: train --balance tasks; dataset fractions: train --mix. Blue-only runs (B_*): no red/green data; eval_steps 'plateau' evaluates the earliest checkpoint after init_from whose blue probe accuracy is within 2/32 of the best (plateau.json). B2_*: 75% blue / 25% red/green (+recovery) per batch (--mix, blue split by frames), lr 1e-5 constant after a 200-step warmup, early stopping (early_stop: probe every 250 steps, blue only; stop when blue accuracy and nearest-cube distance plateau for 1k steps, cap 4k; checkpoint = best blue accuracy with nearest-cube distance <= 3.5 cm, selected.json). stages: this run's own stage list (replaces the job's --stages; self_improve runs must list it). Validation seeds: an eval variant with --seed_base 5000000 (tag _br_zn_val) is used for selection (checkpoints, self_improve_best), the standard seeds only for reporting. eval_k_final: episodes at the last listed eval step (default eval_k). evalsets: {name: {tag, args, items: [[run, step, k], ...]}} evaluate existing checkpoints in order (python colab/dcad.py run <name>); status and log in <OUT>/<name>.

P_only._note: smolvla_base post-trained on the 38 successful blue phone replays only (sessions 3+4: 11/13/14 per blue task), naive loss, no sim/recovery data; cosine 1e-4 -> 2.5e-6 over 20k (VLM 1e-5), checkpoints every 2.5k; blue probe at every checkpoint; zero-noise blue eval (50/task) at 5k/10k/20k + the best probe step

S_only._note: control for P_only: the same recipe on the same number of clean sim blue episodes per task (11/13/14)

T1R_sim_100._note: single task blue-orange from the red/green recovery+decay checkpoint (step 33k) on 100 clean sim demos (first 100 of sim_bo_320); T1 recipe: 500-step warmup, cosine 1e-4 -> 2.5e-6 (VLM 1e-5) over 15k steps; zero-noise eval (20 episodes) at the midpoint and the end. Compare T1_sim_80/160 from smolvla_base

PB_naive._note: phone-only single task blue-orange from the recovery+decay checkpoint, T1R recipe; all blue-orange phone replays (incl. failed), naive loss. Add the new recording session's dataset to data and rescore (scripts/score_phone.py) before running.

PB_amb._note: phone-only single task blue-orange from the recovery+decay checkpoint, T1R recipe; score-based split: top 30% clean (full supervision), the rest ambient with per-episode t_min 0.5-0.9 by score. Add the new recording session's dataset to data and rescore (scripts/score_phone.py) before running.

PB_qual._note: phone-only single task blue-orange from the recovery+decay checkpoint, T1R recipe; quality-tagged: score -> tag appended to the state, inference requests +1. Add the new recording session's dataset to data and rescore (scripts/score_phone.py) before running.

J_sim40._note: joint training from smolvla_base: red/green clean (600) + recovery (360) + 40 clean sim blue-orange demos (stand-in for the phone replays), mix 44/26/30% per batch; V0+recovery recipe in one run: constant 1e-4 (VLM 1e-5) to 30k, cosine to 2.5e-6 at 33k; checkpoints and all-cube probe every 2.5k; STOP if the blue probe is <= 0.40 at 15k; zero-noise eval at 15k/30k/33k: blue-orange 50, red/green 10 per task

S1_sim_50._note: constrained single-object task (env v3s: only the blue cube, fixed red zone, cube in a 10x10 cm box) from smolvla_base on 50 clean sim demos (first n of sim_v3s_200); T1 recipe (cosine over 15k); zero-noise eval (20 episodes) at the midpoint and the end. Reference for the phone runs

S1_sim_100._note: constrained single-object task (env v3s: only the blue cube, fixed red zone, cube in a 10x10 cm box) from smolvla_base on 100 clean sim demos (first n of sim_v3s_200); T1 recipe (cosine over 15k); zero-noise eval (20 episodes) at the midpoint and the end. Reference for the phone runs

S1b_sim_50._note: S1_sim_50 on the real recording layout (env v3s with single_zone_xy 0.42, 0.27 and cube box 0.055-0.132 m, matching phone session 5): 50 clean sim demos (first 50 of sim_v3s2_200) from smolvla_base, T1 recipe, zero-noise eval 20 at 7.5k/15k. Reference for the phone runs

S1b_sim_15._note: sim reference for the phone runs: single-object task on the real recording layout, 15 clean sim demos (first 15 of sim_v3s2_200) from smolvla_base; cosine over 10k (T1 convention for n <= 30); zero-noise eval 20 at 5k/10k

S1b_sim_30._note: sim reference for the phone runs: single-object task on the real recording layout, 30 clean sim demos (first 30 of sim_v3s2_200) from smolvla_base; cosine over 10k (T1 convention for n <= 30); zero-noise eval 20 at 5k/10k

P5_naive_15._note: phone-only single-object task (session 5, blue lid -> red patch) from smolvla_base: the first 15 clips in recording order (nested sets), every extracted replay incl. failed ones, naive loss (sigma ignored); cosine over 10k; zero-noise eval 20 at the midpoint and the end; 2026-10-14 re-eval only (stages eval): _br_zn_go = the same zero-noise episodes with per-episode cube start and grasp offset in episodes.csv (scripts/grasp_vs_train.py)

P5_naive_30._note: phone-only single-object task (session 5, blue lid -> red patch) from smolvla_base: the first 30 clips in recording order (nested sets), every extracted replay incl. failed ones, naive loss (sigma ignored); cosine over 10k; zero-noise eval 20 at the midpoint and the end; 2026-10-14 re-eval only (stages eval): 40 episodes at 10k (eval_k_final; the first 20 are the same seeds), the naive reference for P5_amb_30

P5_naive_60._note: phone-only single-object task (session 5, blue lid -> red patch) from smolvla_base: the first 60 clips in recording order (nested sets), every extracted replay incl. failed ones, naive loss (sigma ignored); cosine over 15k; zero-noise eval 20 at the midpoint and the end

P5_naive_all._note: phone-only single-object task (session 5, blue lid -> red patch) from smolvla_base: the first all clips in recording order (nested sets), every extracted replay incl. failed ones, naive loss (sigma ignored); cosine over 15k; zero-noise eval 20 at the midpoint and the end

P5_naive_15r._note: P5_naive_15 again (same args and seed) with checkpoints every 2.5k: the success curve at fixed steps (did the 85% -> 55% drop from 5k to 10k come from late memorization of phone noise?); its 5k/10k vs P5_naive_15 measure run-to-run nondeterminism. _br_zn: the standard eval seeds (reported at every fixed step); _br_zn_val: separate validation seeds (seed_base 5,000,000) for any checkpoint or method selection, so the reported numbers are on seeds no choice was made with

P5_amb_15._note: ambient at N=15: per-episode t_min from the quality scores (clean = the top 30% of these N clips by quality score, quality/phone_s5_first15.json). Same recipe as P5_naive_15 (cosine over 10k, seed 0) with checkpoints every 2.5k, evaluated at every fixed step (20 episodes; 40 at the final one) on the standard seeds (_br_zn, reported) and on validation seeds (_br_zn_val, seed_base 5,000,000; selection only)

P5_qual_15._note: quality-tagged at N=15 (eval asks for high quality). Same recipe as P5_naive_15 (cosine over 10k, seed 0) with checkpoints every 2.5k, evaluated at every fixed step (20 episodes; 40 at the final one) on the standard seeds (_br_zn, reported) and on validation seeds (_br_zn_val, seed_base 5,000,000; selection only)

P5_naive_15_vn._note: naive at N=15 on the velocity-normalized replays (phone_s5_vn, human/velocity_norm.py). Same recipe as P5_naive_15 (cosine over 10k, seed 0) with checkpoints every 2.5k, evaluated at every fixed step (20 episodes; 40 at the final one) on the standard seeds (_br_zn, reported) and on validation seeds (_br_zn_val, seed_base 5,000,000; selection only)

P5_SI_15._note: one self-improvement round on the best of naive / ambient / quality at N=15, chosen on the validation seeds at the final checkpoint (_br_zn_val); reported on the standard seeds (_br_zn)

P5_amb_30._note: ambient at N=30: per-episode t_min from the quality scores (clean = the top 30% of these N clips by quality score, quality/phone_s5_first30.json). Same recipe as P5_naive_30 (cosine over 10k, seed 0) with checkpoints every 2.5k, evaluated at every fixed step (20 episodes; 40 at the final one) on the standard seeds (_br_zn, reported) and on validation seeds (_br_zn_val, seed_base 5,000,000; selection only)

P5_fresh._note: held-out paired eval of existing checkpoints (no retraining): fresh layouts (seed_base 7,000,000; never used for eval, selection or data), the same seeds for every checkpoint (seed_base + task*10000 + k, so the first 100 are shared by the 100- and 200-episode items), zero-noise; listed in priority order (the 200-episode set first)
